answer: Cosignatures are collected in timber, verified in relic, and sparrow names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 23 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Repeating the trick 10 times costs 39 separate deposits and 9 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
